messages:
Ruth (Partnerships): Quick sync: marketplace canary for the driver/stack update scheduled Fri. Need partner ok on hotfix lane + approved announcement language by Thu EOD. @Vik can you confirm vendor-hotfix SLAs? :clock2:
Vik (NVIDIA PM): We can commit to a hotfix build within 24h for critical regressions. We need a reproducible test case and logs. Also will provide signed artifact and SPDX license note.
Diego (Eng - Runtime): Thanks. We're gating on two regressions: tensorcore kernel OOMs under batched concat workload, and degraded KV-cache hit rate when streaming long prompts. I'll attach a failing trace if we hit it in canary.
Tara (SI Integrations): FYI some SIs run on older ROCm stacks; can we add a small ROCm smoke to the canary? We had one customer surface a ROCm-only kernel mismatch last quarter.
Priya (Product): Yes add ROCm-5.x baseline. We also need canary profiles: 
- CANARY_A: batch 1 low-latency
- CANARY_B: batch 32 throughput
- CANARY_C: streaming 4k seq KV pressure
Ruth (Partnerships): Good. Deliverables: vendor-signed checksums, canary test CSV, short statement (1-3 sentences) for marketplace listing, and a rollback playbook.
Vik (NVIDIA PM): We'll upload signed checksums to the shared bucket and provide a short compatibility blurb. ETA Wed 23:59 PT.
Diego (Eng - Runtime): Running a quick local smoke now, command: 
```
# smoke driver canary
python infra/tests/smoke_run.py --driver 540.12 --cuda 12.3 --model gpt2 --batch 1 --duration 300 --log-level debug
```
Diego (Eng - Runtime): Observed a noisy kernel on one SKU at 70% load, collecting perf counters (ptx, sm_eff). Will add to the regression CSV.
Tara (SI Integrations): We'll mirror the smoke on our on-prem image with ROCm 5.4 and report any ABI mismatches.
compliance-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing needs export classification and third-party license approvals before publish. (autochecklist updated)
Priya (Product): Note for announcement teams: if hotfix is required post-canary, marketing needs a 48-hour lead to adjust partner co-marketing copy. Harper (Legal) pinged earlier about this.
Ruth (Partnerships): Minor ask: include a checksum verification snippet in the partner notes. Example we prefer: 
```
# verify sha256
sha256sum redwood-driver-540.12.tgz | grep <vendor-signed-sha256>
```
Vik (NVIDIA PM): We'll include detached signatures (.sig) and the sha256 file.
Diego (Eng - Runtime): One more runtime note: if the canary shows perf delta >8% on tail latency for CANARY_B, runtime will auto-route that SKU to the pinned stable driver via the routing policy: `route.driver_preference = [stable, candidate]`.
Tara (SI Integrations): Sharing internal test results by Thu noon. If we hit a ROCm regression, can we do a targeted hotfix canary on specific SKUs only?
Ruth (Partnerships): Yes, we can scope the canary by SKU and region. Add scope to the matrix and flag any SKU-level blockers.
Priya (Product): Final checklist for Thu EOD: signed checksums, canary CSV, short compatibility blurb, rollback steps, and marketing hold notice if hotfix required.
Vik (NVIDIA PM): Confirmed. We'll also attach a short note about tested SKUs and driver ABI notes.
Diego (Eng - Runtime): I'll push the regression matrix and a condensed triage doc by Thu 18:00 PT.
Ruth (Partnerships): Perfect. Closing for now; will re-open if any blocker shows up during canary. Ping me for urgent escalations. :thumbsup:
